# restate_subscription (Data Source)

A Kafka subscription, looked up by ID. Useful for reading a subscription created outside this configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a subscription created outside this configuration -- by the Restate CLI, or by an earlier
# Terraform state. `options` includes the defaults the server applied, not only what was requested.

data "restate_subscription" "orders" {
  id = "sub_1a2b3c"
}

output "consumes" {
  value = data.restate_subscription.orders.source
}

output "invokes" {
  value = data.restate_subscription.orders.sink
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Subscription ID to look up, for example `sub_1a2b3c`.

### Read-Only

- `options` (Map of String) Consumer options, including any defaults the server applied.
- `sink` (String) Handler the subscription invokes.
- `source` (String) Kafka topic the subscription consumes.
